description: How the application works, in its own domain terms: who uses it, what it can do, the things it deals with, the processes and events that move them, and the rules and decisions that constrain them. Technology-agnostic: no languages, frameworks, vendors, files, tables, or endpoints. Code locations belong in an entity's sources, never in its properties.

Area.description: A part of the system grouped by the responsibility it owns, named in domain terms (e.g. Billing, Onboarding), not by how it is packaged

Actor.description: Who or what acts on the system or is acted on by it: a person's role, an outside system named by its role (e.g. Payment provider, not a vendor), or the passage of time

Capability.description: Something the system lets an actor do or get, stated as an outcome (e.g. Refund an order)

Concept.description: A thing the domain deals with and what it means here (e.g. Order, Subscription), including the states it moves through

Process.description: An ordered sequence of steps that turns a trigger into an outcome, described as behavior, not as calls between parts

Event.description: Something that happens in the domain that other behavior reacts to, named in the past tense (e.g. Payment failed)

Rule.description: A business rule or invariant the system must keep true; breaking it is a bug

Decision.description: Why the system behaves the way it does: a recorded choice and its reasoning

part_of.description: Belongs to a larger area of responsibility; each thing has one parent

uses.description: An actor uses a capability or takes part in a process

realized_by.description: A capability is delivered by this process

involves.description: A process step touches this; put the step in props, e.g. {"step": 2}

reads.description: Relies on information about a concept without changing it

changes.description: Creates, changes, or ends a concept; put a state change in props, e.g. {"to_state": "paid"}

relates_to.description: One concept is associated with another; put the shape in props, e.g. {"kind": "has_many"}

is_a.description: A concept is a kind of another concept

depends_on.description: Cannot work without this other area, capability, or outside system

constrains.description: A rule that applies to this

supersedes.description: A newer decision replacing an older one
